title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) supports coordinated decision-making in distributed Web services, multi-robot control, and collaborative games through learned coordination conventions. When deployment requirements change, a previously useful convention may become obsolete or unsafe. For example, revised cache-sharing permissions in Web content delivery may require caches to abandon a learned division of storage and serving roles while maintaining efficient delivery. Teams must therefore remove the specified convention while preserving useful cooperation. This is challenging because the same relational pattern can be reproduced by different agents across different histories. Runtime shielding leaves the underlying coordination preference intact and can impair task progress, while existing reinforcement unlearning and trajectory-deletion methods do not directly target role-invariant conventions. translated_title: 当合作必须改变时：多智能体强化学习中的语义策略遗忘
translated_abstract: 合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过学习到的协调约定，支持分布式Web服务、多机器人控制和协作游戏中的协同决策。当部署需求发生变化时，先前有用的约定可能变得过时或不安全。例如，Web内容交付中修订的缓存共享权限可能要求缓存放弃已学习的存储与服务角色分工，同时保持高效的交付。因此，团队必须在保留有用合作的同时移除指定的约定。这具有挑战性，因为相同的关系模式可以由不同智能体在不同历史中重现。运行时屏蔽会保留底层的协调偏好并可能损害任务进度，而现有的强化遗忘和轨迹删除方法并未直接针对角色不变的约定。本文形式化了（注：摘要原文在此处截断，不完整）
tldr: 本文提出了多智能体强化学习中的“语义策略遗忘”新问题：当部署需求变化时，需在保留有用合作的前提下，移除可由不同智能体以角色不变方式重现的特定协调约定。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes semantic strategy unlearning in cooperative MARL, enabling teams to remove a specified role-invariant coordination convention while preserving useful cooperation when deployment requirements change.
